description: This file defines a C# class 'Route' used for JavaScript interop in a Blazor application. It provides a method to invoke a routing function outside the application via JSInterop.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: A class facilitating routing actions from Blazor via JavaScript interop using IJSRuntime.

methods.name: RouteOutside
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a JavaScript function to change route or navigate outside the Blazor app.
